time_basis: NFPlugin on_init arrival order. Context watermark is the prefix maximum of observed first-seen milliseconds. Each window is [watermark-window, watermark); exclude every same-watermark peer. Preserve raw timestamps, report late starts and warm-up span. No label-conditioned history or retrospective timestamp sorting.
acceptance: Independent synthetic window cases and known PCAP initialization order; unchanged core/statistical values and label joins; contiguous initialization sequence and prefix watermark; full sorted-by-initialization replay plus 100 independent SQL snapshots per capture; bounded state and complete row identity coverage. All flows, including excluded labels, contribute history. No model fitting.
resource_screen: One meter and sequential captures, <1 GiB sampled tree RSS and <600 seconds per capture excluding prior preparation/verification/downloads. Active state 100k events including pending peers; sidecar and private temporary target databases each capped at512 MiB, 8 MiB cache targets. Sampling is not an OS memory limit.
